blog.title: ScopeGuard: stop giving away free work
blog.description: Log every out-of-scope ask with its hour and dollar impact, then send a clean change-order email — before you do the work.

body.text: The most expensive sentence in freelancing is "sure, I can do that too." It sounds harmless, and then it costs you three unpaid days. ScopeGuard is built for the moment a client asks for one more thing.

Start by writing down what your fixed price covers — the scope snapshot. Then every time a client asks for something extra, log it with an hour estimate. ScopeGuard converts it to dollars instantly, tracks each ask as pending, approved, or rejected, and keeps a running total of unbilled extras. When you are ready to reply, it drafts the change-order email for you: short, factual, and it ends with a question.

items: Freelance designers, developers, and writers on fixed-price projects
Micro-agencies where one silent yes can eat the margin
Anyone who has ever done a week's unpaid work and felt awkward billing for it
Create a project and list what the fixed price covers
Log each out-of-scope ask with an hour estimate
Watch the unbilled total so no ask slips by
Copy the email draft, send it, and mark the ask approved or rejected
